title: Vigil rite style
description: A rite's look (scripts/kit/style.gd). Engines draw only through it. Registry refuses two recipes whose ground + stroke + font + ink are all the same, and the daily draw avoids the previous rite's ground and font.

ground.description: void: flat. radial: centre to edge. paper: mottled stock with fibres. stars: gradient sky, slowly turning. crt: scanlines and a rolling band.

ink.description: Html colour of lines and text.

stroke.description: How a line is laid down: plain, glowing, ink brush, hairline with beads (star chart), snapped to fat pixels, broad calligraphy nib.

nib_angle.description: Degrees; the nib stroke's pen angle.

fade.description: Html colour the host fades through into and out of the rite.
